bio: There are few things more honored among the Freeborn than revenge. It’s nearly sacred – one of the only forms of justice they can agree on. So important was vengeance that one of the first Titans they created was Myrmadir – a weapon that any true Freeborn can Invoke, even if revenge is out of reach.
